name: Sanxiang Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Sanxiang Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and distribution of advanced materials. The company offers zirconia, nano and sponge zirconium, zirconium oxychloride and tetrachloride, silicon tetrachloride, cast modified materials, single crystal fused aluminum, and silica fume, as well as magnesium alloy, liquid metal, and advanced ceramics. It operates in China, the United States, Brazil, Mexico, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Turkey, Holland, Australia, Japan, South Korea, Iran, India, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, Taiwan, and internationally.
